target_rule: For each frozen checkpoint, score target PDB with raw GNN scores.
On validation chain, choose the score threshold maximizing MCC.
Convert that validation threshold to a rank fraction: predicted_positive_residues / n_validation_residues.
On target PDB, select round(rank_fraction * n_target_residues) highest-scoring residues for that seed.
Run unchanged DBSCAN eps=6.0 min_samples=3 on CA coordinates of selected residues.
Choose top cluster by mean raw score, then apply unchanged multi-seed consensus gate.
reason_selected: Best stable scale-invariant candidate in comparison: mean pairwise Jaccard 0.8575, 22 consensus residues, and all three seeds produced valid clustered pockets.
